title: Two decimal places
description:
Read a decimal number and print it with exactly two digits after the point.

| Input | Output |
|---|---|
| 3.14159 | 3.14 |
| 2 | 2.00 |
| 0.005 | 0.01 |

Use `std::fixed` and `std::setprecision` from `<iomanip>`.
hints: `std::cout << std::fixed << std::setprecision(2) << value;` Both settings are sent to `std::cout` before the number.
